The text describes a social engineering tactic known as pretexting or baiting. The survey uses the lure of a "significant discount" (bait) to manipulate James into providing sensitive personal information, such as his mother's maiden name and the name of his first pet. These details are commonly used for identity theft or account recovery attacks, making this a deceptive attempt to harvest credentials under the guise of a simple feedback survey.
